segments.text: I bow to all the Sahaja Yogis of world.
It is very heartening
you see so many of You assembled here
To do The Guru Puja,
To worship your guru in person is regarded as the highest blessing.
But, uh...in My case it's a very different combination that I am Your Mother and Your Guru

You all are created in the same image of Shri Ganesha
who worshipped his mother
and then he became the Adi guru,
first Guru.
He is a primordial essence of mastery
Only the Mother can make
And the motherhood in any guru, whether male or female
can only make a disciple a guru.
So first you have to become the prophets
and develop that mother hood within yourself
then you can make others also prophets.
Now to become a guru,
what do we have to go after our realization?
Guru word means gravity.
Gravity means a person who is grave,
Who Is deep,
Who Is magnetic

that Realization takes place in complete effortlessness.
So normally a guru tries to make his disciples effortless,
Normalement, c'est par ce processus sans effort qu'un guru crée ses disciples.

Cette condition est appelé Praetenya Chaitilyas qui veut dire une relaxation des efforts

your Prayatna Shaitilya, otherwise Kundalini would not have risen.
Then the second stage is Vichara Shaitillyas –
a thoughtless awareness
This also you got it without doing anything.
And the third is complete negation of thought, abhava
and the bliss of peace.
So one has to understand that you have
pass them through three stages
First, when get your realization
all these things come spontaneously for
When you raise the Kundalini of others, these things happen to them spontaneously.
You too have that power now
to raise the Kundalini of people and to establish it in them.

why we have to have vichara shaitilya?

It's not reality!
Thought always stands between you and the reality.

just putting attention to some one
